Gold technical patterns suggest caution.

Gold prices fell below the 200-hour simple moving average (SMA) at 3652.93 on Thursday for the first time since August 22nd, a move that favors spot gold bears. However, the subsequent decline stalled near the breakout point of a bullish flag pattern (around $3628), suggesting caution before setting up a significant decline.

If gold prices break through the $3660 resistance level, they may face resistance in the $3673-3688 range. A breakout from this resistance area could lead to a retest of the $3700 level. A sustained break above the historical peak of $3707 could raise resistance to $3750 or even $3800.

On the downside, the resistance-turned-support level of $3627.88 (the weekly low) could provide immediate support before $3600. If it effectively falls below this level, it may drag the gold price down to the support zone of $3600-3592, and then fall to the $3583-3577 area, which is expected to provide strong support for spot gold.
